text:
Noah (PMM): quick thread  We need a localized battlecard + two short launch posts for the webinar targeted at EMEA. Make the claims probe-resistant vs cloud providers and infra vendors and add currency-neutral pricing language.
Sofia (EMEA Growth): audience note: buyers care more about predictable latency across regions and data residency. keep two headline variants, one EU-friendly.
Ravi (Field): reps need 3 one-liners: latency, cost, data controls. Also a migration soundbite that mentions "no infra rewrite."
Claire (Bench): bench topline we can share gated: p95 < 150ms at 1k rps in eu-region tests; batching + KV cache yielded ~2.5-3x token savings on multi-turn sequences; private deployment test passed KMS integration.
Renee (Content): public phrasing = "customer-observed"; field battlecard can show numbers and a 1-slide anonymized prompt example comparing Redwood vs a managed endpoint.
Evan (Sales Ops): routing rule: if lead.region == EMEA and company_size > 250 => route to EMEA AE; else SDR. Tag leads clicking benchmark assets with "emea_bench". Also surface GDPR flag if lead.requests_data_residency == true.
Noah (PMM): proposed public-safe lines:
- "Customer-observed p95 < 150ms in EU-region runs"
- "Measured token savings (up to ~3x) with batching and prefix caching"
- "Single API across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments; supports customer-managed keys"
Ravi (Field): internal one-liners:
- Latency: "Ask for the EU benchmark slide  p95 < 150ms under sustained load"
- Cost: "We typically see ~2.5-3x token efficiency on multi-turn chat after batching and light quantization"
- Data controls: "Support for customer-managed KMS and VPC private control plane"
Renee (Content): quick rebuttals (3):
- "Why not just use the cloud provider in-region?" -> "Providers offer instances but not an opinionated serving runtime with tail protection, KV caching, and routing policies. Redwood gives production controls without rebuilding infra."
- "Isn't owning the model enough to solve latency?" -> "Serving determines runtime behavior; model ownership is one piece. We optimize kernels, batching, and KV cache to keep latency predictable."
- "What about compliance & keys?" -> "We support customer-managed keys and private control planes for regulated workloads; ask for the gated appendix."
Sofia (EMEA Growth): headline variants for ads/email:
A) "Keep LLM latency predictable across regions — a practical playbook"
B) "Why managed endpoints don't solve production tail latency"
Decision: run A in EU paid social, B in nurture emails. Tag ad clicks with opener=emeaA.
Claire (Bench): deliverables: 1) 2-slide EU benchmark summary + short appendix (due 3977774600) 2) anonymized prompt comparison slide (included).
Renee (Content): deliverables: 1) EU-facing public post (customer-observed phrasing) 2) 1-page internal battlecard with 6 rebuttals and 3 soundbites (due 3977774700).
Evan (Sales Ops): I'll add SFDC routing + tag automation and create AE tasks for emeab_bench leads (due 3977774800).
assets-bot: uploaded s3://redwood-assets/marketing/webinar-397777/eu-bench.pdf at 3977774555
Noah (PMM): measurement: experiment key "webinar_emea_opener" track opener, utm, benchmark_cta clicks, and GDPR data residency flags. Check-in here in 8h. Move fast. :european_castle:
